heading: 13.1 Overview
text:
### 13.1 Overview [LUNI.13.1]

- Each currency is its own `unit dimension` (`currency_usd`, `currency_eur`,
  `currency_jpy`, …) with `storage int64` and base = the ISO 4217 minor unit
  (cent / pence / yen / fils / …). The standard library ([LUNI.16.5]
  `units.currency`) declares the canonical ISO 4217 set.
- Cross-currency conversion is declared via [LUNI.4.6]
  `unit fx_pair`, backed at runtime by `FxRate` facts ([LUNI.13.3]).
- Every operation that lands a non-exact intermediate (`Float × currency`,
  `currency / Float`, FX conversion) into currency storage requires an explicit
  `.round("<mode>")` call ([LUNI.13.5]). The `<mode>` argument is a
  required string literal — there is no default. This is the load-bearing
  rule.
